name: DTC Static Ad Prompts
tagline: 40 complete templates for direct-to-consumer static advertising.
intro: A text library for DTC marketers and creative teams working with physical consumer products. Browse six creative families, copy a complete English prompt, and fill it with your own brand and product details. The library preserves all 40 template bodies; usage guidance is kept separately.

quick_steps.1: Choose a template by the message and layout you need from the complete menu below.
quick_steps.2: Prepare your brand identity, product facts, approved copy, and any reference images required by that template.
quick_steps.3: Copy the entire prompt and replace its bracketed inputs in a working copy. Check every visible claim against your campaign brief.
quick_steps.4: Use the filled prompt in an image tool that supports the requested inputs. Set the aspect ratio from the prompt body and review the result.

quick_note: Read the separate usage guide for reusable briefs, image-reference requirements, and template-specific exceptions. Prompts stay in English in every language edition.
news: 2026-11-05 — First text edition: 40 templates in six categories, with separate usage guidance.
menu_intro: The case numbers are stable across all categories and language editions.
acknowledge: Suggestions that improve navigation, translations, or usage explanations are welcome. Read the contribution guide before proposing a change to a template body.

category_descriptions.messaging-offers: Headline, offer, manifesto, and statement-led layouts.
category_descriptions.testimonials-social-proof: Testimonial, comment, review-card, and social-proof layouts.
category_descriptions.benefits-data: Benefit lists, annotations, statistics, and product-information layouts.
category_descriptions.comparisons-transformations: Side-by-side comparisons, grids, and before/after layouts.
category_descriptions.editorial-native: Press, editorial, story, notes-app, and curiosity-led formats.
category_descriptions.lifestyle-product: Action scenes, product ranges, bundles, flavor stories, and casual product displays.
